fusions.name: Command Down the Line
fusions.desc: Points the order down the line at a target up to 7 tiles away, dealing 28 damage, up to 1.8 times that at full reach. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 14 seconds.

fusions.name: Bellowed Order
fusions.desc: Bellows an order in a wide cone, dealing 6 damage to everything caught in it, with a 30% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 5 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Edict Held
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 15% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Crier
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.3 seconds.
